# `h`

Helper: `h h1 h2 h3 h4`  
Kit (`src/ui`): heading element (`PageHeading` for a page title; no component for h2-h4) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaHeading` (core:ui), `PemaSection` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Optional eyebrow, the heading, optional sub line.

## Variants

- h1 (title 25/700, heading colour)
- h2 (subtitle 20/700)
- h3 (section 16/700)
- h4 (body-lg 15/600, ink)

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

heading, ink, ink-soft (sub line, label 12), info (eyebrow)

## Do

- Use the level for hierarchy, not for size
- Put a sub line under it only when it adds information

## Don't

- Do not use h1 for a card title (a card has its own title)
- Do not set a size or colour in a part

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Block-level text; the page title is `pageHead`, not `h`.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

h1 = page/hero title 25, h2 = 20, h3 = card title 16, h4 = 15. Optional sub line and eyebrow
